pool.notes: Crisis necessity imports, the stage-1 suffix sites (:564/:567/:570), the stage-5 military/slave rows, and the tradeDependencies impact lines. ⚠ The stage-1 primaryExports (all three suffix sites) is DISCARDED at :811 (primaryExports.length = 0) and rebuilt from deriveExportsFromChains: these suffix rows reach no output, only the stage-5 dedupe checks (:644 military/mercenary, :658 slave) read the interim list. The crisis necessity imports DO survive (passed into deriveImportsFromChains at :778).

rows.notes: A FOURTH parenthetical tag, outside the three-suffix inventory. Dedupe tests includes('Iron') but pushes 'Iron (weapons)', so a necessity 'Iron' and 'Iron (weapons)' can co-print.
DEAD (overwritten :811). Condition: stressTypes under_siege AND worldLaw.supportsMaritime(); slice(0,3).
DEAD (overwritten :811). Condition: occupied, not under_siege; slice(0,5).

DEAD (overwritten :811). Condition: no siege/occupation AND route crossroads|port|river; items = tradeStreams.transit. Note the route set differs from deriveIsEntrepot (river never makes an entrepot, so transit is empty there).

rows.text: Military services — standing army leasing, siege engineering, garrison contracts
rows.notes: CATEGORY: a service as an export. Branch tier >= village, militaryEffective >= 80, name mercenary/garrison/barracks/professional guard (private). unhomed: standing army.

rows.text: Mercenary services — trained companies available for hire
Military services — garrison contracts and armed escort
Slave trade: transit market for human trafficking; imported labour and exported captives
rows.notes: unhomed: slavery boundary (content profile). isSlaveMarket && isCaptiveSource (occupied or criminalEff > 65).

rows.text: Slave labour: purchased workforce for agricultural estates, mines, and domestic service
rows.notes: unhomed: slavery boundary. Names 'mines' without a mine. Listed as an EXPORT though the words describe a purchased (imported) workforce.

rows.text: Captive trade: war captives and debtors sold through established trafficking networks
rows.notes: unhomed: slavery boundary. 'war captives' presumes war (war: at war) — branch is occupied OR criminalEff>65, not war; left as a note.

rows.text: Slave trade: human trafficking and forced labour; legally tolerated or actively regulated
Enslaved labour: purchased from regional trafficking networks
Supply route severed. Operating at minimal capacity or shut down.
rows.notes: isUnderStress: stressTypes|intendedStressTypes under_siege OR institution named 'war council'|'siege'|'rationing' (private; a name alone asserts a siege).

rows.text: No trade access: running on existing stockpiles only.
Supplied via magical trade infrastructure: teleportation imports replace road access.
Dependent on trade routes. Siege, road closure, or blockade would impair operations.
rows.notes: Counterfactual "would impair" is false under an active siege — but the siege arm takes precedence, so this prints under every crisis EXCEPT siege. Declared calm per the ruling; narrower: excludes under_siege only.
